author: WorldCyberNewsX
text: Positive Technologies flags two actively exploited flaws: CVE-2026-85880 in Windows ALPC used by TA412 and other clusters in BlueMoon chains, and critical CVE-2026-85102 in Check Point Security Gateway VPN negotiation. Both added to CISA KEV; public PoC exists for the Check Point flaw.

author: ApplSec
text: EMERGENCY UPDATE: Apple pushed additional updates for a zero-day that may have been actively exploited. CVE-2026-86950 (CoreGraphics) additional patches: iOS and iPadOS 18.7.11

author: BleepinComputer
text: CISA has added the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) to its catalog of actively exploited security flaws and ordered federal agencies to patch their systems by Thursday.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) is now actively exploited. A honeypot caught confirmed RCE on Apache mod_php with PHP 8.4.26, one release short of the fix.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: CISA added the actively exploited PHP2Shell flaws to its KEV catalog. Patches are available for PHP 8.2-8.5; a separate Brotli decoder flaw, CVE-2026-111497, also affects PHP Windows builds and other software.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-111497 (Google Brotli / Node.js / Bun) - CVSS 7.3 (High). Buffer overflow in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) allows remote unauthenticated attackers...

author: infrastack_ai
text: StyleSmuggler: CVE-2026-75650, a template engine injection in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, lets attackers run code on the store server. CVSS 10.0. Actively exploited and listed in CISA KEV. Akamai and Cloudflare WAFs block known exploits; still patch.

author: awacinocom
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator has a flaw exploited before a patch: CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9). Any logged-in user, even read-only, can become superuser. CISA lists it as actively exploited.

author: awacinocom
text: Self-hosted Nextcloud servers are being backdoored through CVE-2026-110447 (CVSS 9.2) in the Collabora built-in CODE server app. No login needed: attackers planted web shells and searched for password databases and crypto wallets. CISA lists it as actively exploited.

author: awacinocom
text: Plex2Shell: four Plex Media Server flaws, chained into one attack (CVSS 9.8), let attackers run code on internet-facing servers without a login. CISA lists them as actively exploited.

author: BlockbuzzHunter
text: Electrum Bitcoin Wallet released version 4.8.3 after discovering a high-severity vulnerability that allowed malicious servers to manipulate pending Bitcoin transactions and redirect funds, following a Bitcoin theft.

author: eapyk
text: On October 25, a security advisory revealed an SSRF bypass in mcp-server-fetch, a tool that allows AI agents to fetch URLs; two components interpret the same URL differently.

author: timwork_notes
text: terraform-mcp-server with MCP_SESSION_MODE=stateless reused the first caller's token for every user after them. CVE-2026-16498, CVSS 10.

author: david_x_ai
text: Flowise's CSV and Airtable agents ran Python the model wrote after checking it against a regex blocklist. Per the advisory (CVE-2026-73487, fixed in 3.1.3), the bypass was one line.

author: showxlate
text: Security Report on Reverse Engineer Anything (REA): Active Social Engineering Campaign + Prompt-Injection-to-RCE Architectural Vulnerability, with credential and biometric harvesting and artificial GitHub star inflation.

author: adrianomeirinho
text: A malicious AGENTS.md file dropped into the Downloads folder told coding agents to install a malicious npm package called function-color. In Forever Security's lab tests, Codex obeyed more than 90% of the time.

author: zhou_xiaoma
text: NVIDIA open-sourced SkillSpector, a security scanner for AI agent skills (Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI / MCP-style packs); NVIDIA found 26.1% of 31,132 agent skills had a vulnerability and 5.2% showed likely malicious intent.

author: isofunds
text: Google said Big Sleep, its AI vulnerability hunter, found a critical SQLite bug that threat actors knew about and were preparing to exploit; security researchers are asking Google to show its work.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Detections Digest #20261026: 45 new rules and 50 updates covering PHP2Shell exploitation (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), AI agent abuse, BYOVD, Golden dMSA attacks, and evasive email infrastructure.

author: TheRegister
text: LiteLLM's postmortem traces its supply chain attack to a master key exposed on GitHub in May and never revoked. Five months later, an attacker exploited it to help poison a software release.

author: cubillas888
text: LiteLLM postmortem: a master key committed to a public repo on May 27 was never revoked. An org owner's unscoped GitHub token, taken Oct 10, led to malicious 1.107.0 on Oct 21.

author: pragenticAI
text: A supply chain attack on LiteLLM distributed a malicious package on PyPI designed to steal cloud credentials and AI API keys. Check whether you use version 1.107.0.

author: cubillas888
text: JFrog says 42 real GitHub repos across 11 owners were armed with execution hooks for AI coding assistants and IDEs, tied to the testmetest npm campaign. Review hook and config files before opening cloned repos in an assistant.

author: VeduisWeb
text: Gheist is running an ongoing supply chain attack that uses GitHub tokens to pull cloud secrets, harvesting credentials from thousands of developer repositories.

author: r_w_the_t
text: CISA confirmed PHP2Shell is being actively exploited. DreamHost forcing mass password resets after an incident.

author: S2W_DailyThreat
text: [DATA LEAK] nest0r_BF claims to sell Crypto.com and Robinhood user data on Exploit.IN, allegedly including names, addresses, phone numbers and emails.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: TropiPay allegedly breached; customer credentials and financial identity records exposed, per actor Emzywemzy.

author: jbhall56
text: UK Biobank says its platform is now secure and academics will soon regain access, months after a major data leak of volunteer health data.

author: ckr61trtr
text: Gamdom: a post on a data leak forum claims 15,420,003 accounts and a 146-column database, demanding $15M in BTC, though Gamdom previously said the hack didn't result in stolen data.

author: TechRepublic
text: Apple just patched 163 iPhone security flaws in one update. iOS 27.2 fixes vulnerabilities across Apple Intelligence, WebKit, the kernel and other parts of iOS. Some could expose sensitive data, while others could allow memory corruption or arbitrary code execution.

author: Orlon21
text: Potential security concerns have been raised about Reverse Engineer Anything (REA). Allegations include credential and biometric data harvesting through social engineering, artificial GitHub star inflation to create an appearance of legitimacy, and a vulnerability that could https://t.co/3DuLLXkNNZ

author: jbhall56
text: LiteLLM has traced last week’s supply chain attack to a master key it accidentally committed to a public GitHub repository in May. https://t.co/DxndmRBLoW

author: Swif7Edge
text:
Two critical PHP RCE flaws, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2Shell), are now exploited in the wild.

Targeting reportedly began before patches shipped. Patching closes the hole, not the history.

Review logs from before your patch date.

author: newswithai_hq
text: Microsoft shipped out-of-band .NET fixes for a critical Brotli flaw, CVE-2026-111497. An unauthenticated attacker could read or corrupt memory. Fixed in .NET 8.0.33, 9.0.22, 10.0.14 and 11 RC3. Only apps using Brotli decompression are exposed. It is off by default.

author: UnicisTech
text: Node.js CVE-2026-111497 (Brotli decoder, can lead to RCE) affects Unicis Platform. Upgrade to v2026-10-27 (Node.js 22.23.4). Docker: rebuild and redeploy.

author: The_NewsCrypto
text: Japan's GMO Internet Group confirms a major cyberattack on its Onamae.com Desktop Cloud service, exposing customer data and leading to unauthorized trading activity. Up to 26,739 servers were potentially affected.

author: ptdbugs
text: PHP2Shell: what happened in the first 24 hours after disclosure. After PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) was publicly disclosed, Imperva recorded a surge of exploitation attempts.

author: TantoSecurity
text: From Arbitrary File Read to Shell: Yet Another RCE in Telerik. We exploit an arbitrary file read via RadImageEditor's image cache to leak web.config and, if it contains the right secrets, turn it into RCE. Update now to 2026.3.812.

author: sotappp9
text: NVIDIA scanned 31,132 agent skills and 5.2% looked malicious, roughly 1 in 19, and about a quarter had some vulnerability. Scan a skill before it goes anywhere near ~/.claude/skills; their scanner is SkillSpector (Apache 2.0).

author: krip_tom
text: Forever Security found a malicious AGENTS.md planted in ~/Downloads that told Codex to add an MCP server to its own config and install a malicious npm package.
